text: Evangelists are clergy women from the Cathedral of the Deep who torment and harvest the undead in the Undead Settlement.
The Abyss Watchers were an elite order of Undead warriors who modeled themselves after Artorias, dedicating themselves to destroying the Abyss wherever it appeared.

Pontiff Sulyvahn stationed the Dancer of the Boreal Valley and a division of Outrider Knights in Lothric, with Vordt guarding the High Wall of Lothric and the Dancer guarding Lothric Castle, to sow chaos and guard against interference with his plans.
The Corvian Knights serve Sister Frieda and hunt down and kill any refugees who pray for the cleansing flame's return.
The Ringed Knights are warriors who once served Gwyn's firstborn son before he was exiled and erased from history.
Ringed Knights are branded with rings of fire meant to seal the darkness within them.
The Way of White is a religious order dedicated to preserving the Age of Fire, teaching that linking the flame is a sacred, noble sacrifice.
The Dark Wraiths serve Darkstalker Kaathe and believe the Age of Dark is humanity's birthright, stolen by Gwyn's fear and pride.

The Sable Church of Londor, represented at Firelink Shrine by Yuria after Yoel's death, seeks to usurp the First Flame's power for humanity's own use rather than letting it die, a plan it has long pursued.
Archdeacon McDonnell and other Cathedral of the Deep leaders became corrupted by Aldrich's prophetic vision, turning the cathedral into a temple dedicated to him.
Sulyvahn joined the Dark Moon Blades, a covenant dedicated to protecting Gwyndolin, rising through the ranks while planning betrayal.
Sulyvahn created the Outrider Knights, warriors wearing rings that grant power while slowly transforming them into beasts and eroding their sanity.
Gwyn's firstborn son founded the Warriors of Sunlight, a covenant dedicated to cooperation and mutual aid, and trained Ornstein, who became his first knight.
